mapper.sql: s.scrap_id AS scrapId, s.scrap_no AS scrapNo, s.asset_id AS assetId, s.asset_dept_id AS assetDeptId, s.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, s.dispose_type AS disposeType, s.reason, s.apply_time AS applyTime, s.status, s.completed_time AS completedTime, s.create_by AS createBy
mapper.select: SELECT , a.asset_code AS assetCode, a.asset_name AS assetName, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.nick_name AS applicantName FROM ca_scrap s JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = s.asset_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.applicant_user_id WHERE s.scrap_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_scrap WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND status IN ('0','1') AND scrap_id != #{excludeId}

SELECT a.audit_id AS auditId,a.scrap_id AS scrapId,a.audit_level AS auditLevel, a.audit_result AS auditResult,a.auditor_user_id AS auditorUserId, u.nick_name AS auditorName,a.audit_opinion AS auditOpinion,a.audit_time AS auditTime FROM ca_scrap_audit a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=a.auditor_user_id WHERE a.scrap_id=#{id} ORDER BY a.audit_level
